### Added
- `gitops.forbidPinnedLoginConnector` (default `false`): with `true` the render fails when `muster.muster.oauth.server.dex.connectorId` is set, naming the key. A pinned connector makes muster (through mcp-oauth) append `connector_id` to every Dex authorization request, so Dex's connector chooser never appears; on an installation whose Dex serves several identity providers — the operator's and the tenant's — the pin hides every other connector, and people from those providers either cannot sign in to muster or, when the pinned connector is not the provider their MCP-server allowlists (`allowedGroups`, RBAC) are written for, receive a token without those groups. Backstage and the kagent UI leave the choice to Dex; the knob lets a fleet template hold muster to the same rule against a per-installation override, at render time and with the same shape as `gitops.forbidInlineSecrets`. Meta-package plumbing: not forwarded to the muster release. **No installation needs to act**: off by default, every render is unchanged. `make verify-login-connector` asserts the four cases (default renders and forwards a pin; on plus a pin fails naming the key and never repeating the value; on plus an empty or absent key renders; the knob reaches no child release).
